the old version just seemed so much better from both players and devs' perspective, it's weird that it got scrapped at all
i liked touching A5 when i was ready, and A4x2 when i wasn't

Light went we need a whale flex mode because nobody cares about madness train anymore how do we make it as bad as possible

Squeezing the whales every 2 weeks seems like a burnout Speedrun
true 💔 the change amongst other feel bad
425 was a better flex anyway, you just needed to whale horizontally...
now you just don't have enough chars that can clear to flex xD
Hah you still have.Just now this way harder
yeah, now you have to be a whale *and* know how to play
Anyway gz 10k now
which actually doesn't sound that bad <:Nautila_think:1459077762684948500> but i think whaling *or* skill is better
We'll see how next season goes
This one was the first iteration of it so it was bound to mistakes
Obv if he reduce 10% hp this change nothing)
Those percentages he gave are actually pretty vague
Reducing the strength of a "difficulty" by a certain number doesn't account for unknown nerfs or buffs that happen to enemies themselves (such as previous season Clementine losing a lot of hp)
And as people said, there's not much to say about the current state of dtide
It's mostly solved and hardly anything new will be seen before next season starts
So might as well wait and complain again then xD
Damn, this place really is a second general now, people posting about random games

Those percentages were between so and so which is very bad when your playerbase needs a concrete answer to the complaints, but he lacks self-awareness since he posted about the scintilla BS right after that post
Also, can I remind you that he commented on someone calling out his adding zeros to the thing and calling it a day which is both infuriating and insanely stupid

he did make it very clear it was a progressive reduction starting at the low number on wave 1 and building up to the high number on wave 5, like sure you don't have the exact intervals but i don't think what we were given there was -that- unreasonable really

What if HP in the tide is the base value for subsequent difficulties?From what I’ve seen, it’s literally a certain number, and exactly three times that amount at the next level of difficulty.Then, by reducing the HP on hard... lets say 1m to 800k he reduce nightmare hp from 3m to 2.4 and madness have 7m total...Just i sure he not set hp manualy but ctrl+c ctrl+v in programm xD...Will this still not be enough for you guys?
that would be very funny
No, d-tide should have 1 hp so I can beat it with uvhash and doresain
They still can.But you need 50 turns
Damn, 50 turns to deal 1 hp, last time I checked they needed at least 98
hp is downstream of the main issue, so tweaking numbers is never going to be enough
What do you want then?

you don't have to be a genius to see how creating a large gap between whales and normal players will only make both dissatisfied with balance. the only reason nobody complained about the last version is that low max difficulty served as a bandaid, but now it's been ripped off and everyone suddenly saw the gap.
now they can either put the bandaid back on by backtracking on changes, or figure out how to close the gap, which would most likely just be a nerf that would get everyone outraged anyway.
they basically fucked themselves over 10 steps ahead, but they have a convenient arc 3 they could use for that, and idk why they didn't wait until that for the d-zone changes
Because they wanted to lose all the people they got thanks to the saya collab, I guess, the game was doing very well thanks to that

yeah... and even if arc3 closes the gap, the d-zone changes still suck, they already had the best formula i've seen, and just needed a few small corrections to make it perfect, but instead somehow managed to go in the opposite direction...

if i reworked it, i would:
- remove difficulty changing between waves: the most difficult wave should just be the one that requires a team that you didn't invest into, or didn't learn how to play properly.
- change the points gained for each clear-per-alert down to 1.
- give rewards for each point.
- allow picking alert level for extra clear.
- keep adding more waves/extra-clears as more characters are released.
- prefer adding more alerts over changing balance of alerts due to powercreep: beginners usually don't have enough investment to be affected by powercreep anyway.
- separate highest difficulties' points from the main ones and just give a different pool of rewards: this rewards vertical investment better, and would be a better way to show off when you have a whaled team, but not enough for extra clear.
- either remove ecogs from d-zone, or make them free but limit their uses. but i think it's a bad game mechanic as a whole, and should just be combined with DR.
